description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerService class, which provides methods to interact with performance tracker data, including retrieving the DAO object and updating performance tracker records. It handles business logic related to performance tracking in the HRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerService
classes.description: A service layer class that manages operations related to PerformanceTrackers, including access to the DAO layer and business rules enforcement.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PerformanceTrackerDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: updateTracker
methods.description: Updates a PerformanceTracker record if the tracker owner is editable; throws an exception otherwise.
